boundary_dependence.the branch set, the one-adoption rule, a: does not depend on the admitted boundary as a rule, but every configuration it quotients does: the least key it compares is a key of a placement, and a placement is a side per mark
boundary_dependence.the demand generator, and the requiremen: requires the admitted boundary: a permitted automorphism of a configuration is a renaming of marks and, under U, of the two sides
boundary_dependence.the enumeration generator and what it em: requires the admitted boundary through the declared domain, whose members are wholes delimited by one bar with a side on each hand; the enumeration of that domain and the order on it are declarations the boundary does not decide
boundary_dependence.the generator space, its capabilities, t: does not depend on the admitted boundary
boundary_dependence.the node ceiling, the branching bound, a: does not depend on the admitted boundary: they count branches and rounds and would be stated the same way for any finite branching

branch_space.one_adoption_rule: the base branch adopts nothing and every other declared branch adopts exactly one retained tied-minimum class of one closed rung.  A branch adopting two or more is NOT enumerated: each rung's minimum answers that rung's own requirement and no requirement of the run justifies a second adoption, so the product of the rungs' classes is a wider space about which this stage claims nothing
branch_space.quotient: two branches are the same branch exactly when their branch keys are equal; the key is the declarations in force, the adopted policy's own Challenge 5 class key, and the least key of the configuration under the branch's own permitted renamings

admitted boundary.buys_at_stage_1: every configuration a branch holds, each mark of it lying on a side; the branch set and the generator space are stated without it, and what they range over is not
admitted boundary.declared_at: the seed, as the one admitted primitive exception

side names under O.buys_at_stage_1: one branch fewer and one tie fewer: under O the Challenge 3 minimum is the null point, which adopts nothing, so the branch that carries a third retained whole is a branch of reading U alone
side names under O.declared_at: genesis, as the O reading of the one declaration

the process admits.buys_at_stage_1: nothing on its own: a generator that retains what no source named retains nothing, and one that supplies and retains costs two and is refused as a bundle
the process admits.declared_at: Challenge 3, as the further-mark candidate's one capability (definition 45)
the process admits.paid_by: whichever candidate is taken, and none is taken here

the process supplies.buys_at_stage_1: that a next challenge exists at all: without it the only generator of capability count zero emits nothing and every branch stops for want of a next challenge
the process supplies.declared_at: stage 1, as this stage's own declaration
the process supplies.paid_by: whichever generator is taken, and none is taken here

closes: the declaration of the branches, their challenge generators, and the resource bounds; no round is run

events_named_by_this_stage.what_the_census_cannot_see: the census reads a return annotation; it cannot tell a function that names the events of a recorded history from one that issues a new event, so a clean census would not have been evidence either
events_named_by_this_stage.what_they_return: the recorded caller history each branch replays: the Challenge 4 retention history, extended on the further-mark branch by that class's own declared admission (definition 45)

capability_of.the_process_admits: the process, and not only the caller, issues an admission event.  This is the capability the further-mark candidate of Challenge 3 was priced at (definition 45), read as its admission half: the event it names is an admission, and supply and admission are never conflated
capability_of.the_process_imposes_a_requirement: the process, and not the caller, requires two retained wholes to be internally separable: at Challenges 3 and 4 the caller imposed the requirement and the run answered it
capability_of.the_process_reads_the_state_into_the_pre: the next presentation is computed from the branch's admitted state, so that what the object language holds decides what it is next shown
capability_of.the_process_supplies: the process, and not only the caller, issues a presentation event: definition 25 makes the current state the replay of the CALLER's history, and a challenge the process generates is the first presentation that history does not contain

declared_inputs: the declared 144-member domain of inscriptions and its order
the record of the texts the caller has presented
generator_space.declared_inputs_are_metatheory_because: the domain is the Challenge 5 reader's own enumeration and the presented record is a reading of the history (definition 20 at the level of texts); no regime, deep regime, judgment, or profile is among them, which the substitution census computes rather than asserts
generator_space.exhaustive_because: a generator either names no inscription, or names one without reading the branch's admitted state, or names one by reading it.  Those three exhaust the declared alternatives.  The stage enumerates ONE source of each of the last two kinds — the declared domain enumeration, and the least domain member carrying as many marks as the configuration admits — and not every source of either kind; what a state-reading source costs is the same for all of them, because every one of them reads the state, and that is the only thing this space asks of the third value
generator_space.one_step_rule: a generator is one step exactly when the number of undeclared capabilities it uses is one, and one of two or more bundles capabilities and is refused as a one-step augmentation.  As at Challenge 5 that number is not the number of coordinates moved: the state-reading source moves one coordinate and uses two capabilities
sources: none: the generator names no inscription
enumeration: the least member of the declared domain, in that domain's own order, that the presented record does not carry
state: the least member of the declared domain carrying as many marks as the branch's configuration admits
generator_space.what_a_generated_challenge_is: at most one inscription of the declared domain, supplied; whether that inscription is also retained; and at most one demand that two named retained wholes of the branch be internally separable in the declared sense.  A generator emits a challenge exactly when it produces an inscription or a demand

measures.mu1: capability count: the number of undeclared capabilities the generator uses
measures.no_second_measure_because: the run's second measure has been the number of declared collateral facts a candidate makes internally available that its reading's base did not.  A generator makes no fact available: it changes no admitted state, and this stage runs no round.  So no second measure is declared here, and the tie the first measure leaves on one branch is left standing rather than broken by a measure invented to break it

what_the_stage_exercises.admission: no: nothing is admitted, and the capability that would let the process admit is priced and refused as the second half of a bundle

what_the_stage_exercises.side: yes: every configuration a branch holds is a side per mark, and the branch quotient compares those keys
